name: Belmont Park Play Area
description: Victorian park in Newtown between Belmont Road and Blackboy Road, opened in 1886 as a children's play area and run by Exeter City Council. Its play area has a pony seesaw and a play tower with a house and balcony, aimed at toddlers to young teens.
